description: Fork of exp223 (1.6249 @ 8K, 339M, LUT SOTA). Single change: out_partition_per_head=true — out_proj's TinyMultiHeadLut uses partition_sets=[[0..23], [24..47], ..., [120..143]] which forbids cross-head pairs (each pair (a, b) must have both endpoints in the same head's d_v=24 slice). A single table can still mix pairs drawn from multiple heads; only individual pair endpoints are constrained. Tests whether banning direct cross-head comparisons at out_proj helps.
